name: railway_list_variables
description: INSPECT the environment variables for a service in an environment. Requires `projectId` and `environmentId`; `serviceId` optional (omit to read the environment's shared/project-level variables instead of a service's). Returns `variables` as a JSON object of name -> value. SECURITY: these values are secrets — use them to confirm which keys are set or spot a missing/misconfigured var, but never echo raw secret values back to the user; refer to them by name. Read-only.

serviceId.description: Optional service id (from railway_get_project). Omit to read the environment's shared variables.

body_defaults.query: query variables($projectId: String!, $environmentId: String!, $serviceId: String) { variables(projectId: $projectId, environmentId: $environmentId, serviceId: $serviceId) }
